Your holdings: SOXL is a SELL at -42.74% - it's leveraged and decaying. SPAL is also a concern at -39.95% for the same reasons. CRWD is holding steady at +24.43%.

Watch: Keep an eye on how mortgage rates and consumer prices continue to play out.

Bottom line: Focus on managing your leveraged positions and watching for any signs of continued inflation pressure.

SPAL: TRIM/SELL - similar to SOXL, leverage and decay are significant risks.
